BiblicalUsage: Mirmah is named once, among the sons of Shaharaim. Shaharaim was a Benjamite who had sons by his wives in the country of Moab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single line is enough: Mirmah was a head of his father's house, and the record keeps his name with his brothers.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
